name: Master of the Pageant
summary: Once per battle round, reduce the CP cost of the Sinuous Breach or Prideful Superiority Stratagem by 1 when used on a Fulgrim unit.

name: Sensational Performance
summary: After a Charge move, an Emperor's Children unit that fights can restrict its targets like Thrill Seekers and gain +1 Strength and Armour Penetration on its melee weapons for the phase.
